title: King of Love
lyrics_original: The King of Love my Shepherd is,
Whose goodness faileth never.
I nothing lack if I am His,
And He is mine forever.
Where streams of living water flow,
My ransomed soul He leadeth;
And where the verdant pastures grow,
With food celestial feedeth.
Never failing, Ruler of my heart.
Everlasting, Lover of my soul!
On the mountain high
Or in the valley low,
The King of Love my Shepherd is!
The King of Love my Shepherd is!
Lost and foolish, oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me;
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And home, rejoicing, brought me.
In death's dark vale I fear no ill,
With Thee, dear Lord, beside me;
Thy rod and staff my comfort still,
Thy cross before to guide me.
Never failing, Ruler of my heart!
Everlasting, Lover of my soul!
On the mountain high
Or in the valley low,
The King of Love my Shepherd is!
Never failing, Ruler of my heart.
Everlasting, Lover of my soul!
On the mountain high
Or in the valley low,
The King of Love my Shepherd is!
The King of Love my Shepherd is!
So through all the length of days,
Thy goodness faileth never;
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise,
Within Thy house forever.
Within Thy house forever.

bible_verses.english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
For the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne will be their shepherd, and will guide them to springs of waters of life. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being the King of Love and the Good Shepherd of my soul. When I am prone to worry or wander, remind me that Your goodness and mercy never fail. Lead me beside Your streams of living water and feed my heart with Your truth today. I surrender my fears to You, trusting that I lack nothing in Your presence. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When life feels overwhelming or uncertain, "King of Love" gently reminds us of the Good Shepherd who holds us fast. Jesus does not merely rule over us with power; He leads us with tender, never-failing love that supplies our every need. As you sing today, rest in the quiet assurance that you belong to Him forever. Open your heart to receive His peace, allowing His living water to refresh your weary soul.
